BrochureContent.Content:
New to the market is this wonderful, very spacious , and very well laid out 4 bedroom, 2 bathroom semi detached house in the highly sought after Glenpatrick Estate, in Carrick on Shannon. The beautiful finished interior is complete with an integral garage and a standalone shed to the rear as well as a private manicured tranquil garden. The house is conveniently located to the train station, and close to all amenities including shops, schools and childcare. Downstairs there is a modern spacious sitting room to the front, combined with light dining area , adjacent this is a modern kitchen, large utility area and separate WC. On the first floor you have a spacious bright landing, master bedroom with ensuite shower room. There are 3 further double bedrooms, the family bathroom, and large shelved hot press. To the front there is a paved parking area tastefully complete with a pebbled footpath either side, leading to the gated side entrance. The property is a short walk to the bustling town center and all it has to offer. Glenpatrick is mature sought after residential development within walking distance of the town centre. It is next to the train station and a convenience store. Supermarkets, the local cinema and sports facilities are all nearby.
